title: Exclusive: You Can Finally Buy a Fairphone—a Sustainable, Repairable Smartphone—in the US
summary: The Dutch company is bringing its repairable and sustainably built Android smartphone—the Fairphone (Gen 6+)—to the US. The new Fairphone (Gen 6+) is a small upgrade over the Gen 6 the company launched last year.
